summary: Ceragon Networks filed a Form 6-K (the foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) furnishing a press release announcing product launches and its participation at India Mobile Congress 2026, held October 7-10 in New Delhi. The company unveiled the IP-50EXA-P high-power E-band radio, citing up to 27 dBm transmit power, up to 20 Gbps in 2+0 configuration, and expected commercial availability in Q1 2027, alongside existing IP-100E, Siklu MultiHaul TG and IP-100FR2 products. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation or structural mechanics are disclosed; this is routine product and trade-show news, not a special situation.
